title: Germany's Basic Law (official English text)
limitation: Comparative design source only. The English text is provided for convenience; the German text controls. No German rule is represented as Bhoomi law.

title: South African Constitution (Department of Justice HTML chapters)
limitation: Comparative source only. Its national, provincial and local spheres are distinctive, interdependent and interrelated; they are not described as a federation. The South African allocation and priority rules are not Bhoomi law.

title: Constitution Acts and Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms
limitation: Comparative source only. Canadian federal division of powers, Charter remedies and its limited, renewable notwithstanding mechanism are not Bhoomi law or a recommended single model.

title: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (OHCHR text)
limitation: A treaty text, not a domestic constitution. Treaty obligations apply to States Parties; the Covenant is not represented as binding Bhoomi or as proof of statehood.

title: Convention on the Rights of the Child (OHCHR text)
limitation: A treaty text for its States Parties. It informs child identity and participation safeguards but does not supply a complete citizenship code or make the Convention a Bhoomi obligation.

title: Convention on the Reduction of Statelessness (OHCHR text)
limitation: A treaty text for contracting States, with specified rules and conditions. It is a reference for safeguards against statelessness, not a universal citizenship code or a Bhoomi obligation.
